capabilities: Redirect workspace.json reads and writes to a folder outside the vault
Restore the stored layout after the layout is ready on startup
Write a backup snapshot of the layout at each startup
Patch Node fs functions so writes to the layout file cannot land in the vault
Set the storage folder in plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a workspace switcher or layout manager; it only changes where the workspace layout file is stored.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly, uses Node fs); not yet in the community plugin list, so install is manual. While enabled it drops any other plugin's writes to exactly .obsidian/workspace.json. It does not sync layouts between devices, and it must be enabled on every desktop device that opens the vault. No network access or telemetry.
motivation: The author wanted to stop the sync indicator from spinning constantly and to end the pile of layout conflict copies created across devices.
problem: Folder-based sync services keep re-uploading .obsidian/workspace.json and produce conflict copies when several devices write it.
summary: Desktop plugin that redirects Obsidian's workspace layout file to a folder outside the vault so folder-based sync clients stop re-uploading it.
